name: godmode
description: Your coding agent says "done." Godmode is how you know: a local, tamper-evident evidence ledger of what it did, claimed, and verified - with gates and a completion bar enforced in hooks at runtime. Zero deps, zero network.

requires_host_support.pre_tool_gate: The action gate is a host hook. Hooks are outside the v1 portable format, so a client without hook support installs the skills and no enforcement.
requires_host_support.archive: Continuity records are written under the repository's git metadata directory by the bundled runtime, not by the host.
